mapper.sql: SELECT l.id, l.book_id, l.reader_id, l.borrowed_at, l.due_at, l.returned_at, l.status, l.fine_cents, l.created_at, l.updated_at, b.title AS book_title, r.name AS reader_name FROM loans l JOIN books b ON b.id = l.book_id JOIN readers r ON r.id = l.reader_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loans (book_id, reader_id, borrowed_at, due_at, status) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{readerId}, #{borrowedAt}, #{dueAt}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND status = 'BORROWED'
